games.name: The Glass Bridge
games.desc:
ⓘ THIS GAME IS FINISHED AND WILL (most likely) NOT RECEIVE ANY MORE OFFICIAL UPDATES!

Step into a faithful recreation of the iconic Glass Bridge from Netflix's Squid Game. Test your luck and courage as you race to cross before the 5-minute timer runs out!

The bridge is made of randomized tempered and normal glass. Step on the wrong tile and it will shatter beneath you while tempered glass will hold your weight. Earn 10 points for discovering a safe tile first and 1000 points for reaching the other side. Spend points on abilities like Push or Glass Checker, and climb onto global leaderboards!

Recent Updates:
• push & kick countering
• revives

Upcoming Updates:
